{{Top|leg}}
The '''automated repair upgrade''', also known as the '''scavenger upgrade''', enhanced the self-diagnostics and self-repair capability of a [[Droid/Legends|droid]]. The module allowed it to sustain itself by scavenging parts from the environment as well as from its own non-critical systems.

{{Tech-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
A droid must be at upgrade class 3 to be able to equip the item.

*''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]'' {{1st}}
